name: Generate Requirements from Product Idea
description: Verify that a natural-language product idea produces 8–12 structured IEEE 830 requirements.
pre:
• A valid LLM provider API key is configured in Settings.
• A new, empty project is open; store.requirements is empty.

1

Navigate to Requirements
Engineer

Between 8 and 12 cards are shown,
including both Functional and NonFunctional types.

4

Inspect ID, Priority and Status
on each card

IDs are sequential from REQ-101;
priorities are Critical/High/Medium/Low;
status is Draft.
post:
1. store.requirements contains 8–12 items, all with status Draft.

2. No duplicate requirement IDs exist.
